Media Intelligence Analyst (Student Position)

As a Media Intelligence Analyst, you will be working on PIXMOLE's unique platform to identify and analyze media usage for PIXMOLE's clients. You will be gathering technical information online for our legal department and will take part in protecting copyright for some of the world’s best photographers and artists.

Media Intelligence Analyst

As a Media Intelligence Analyst, you will be working on PIXMOLE's unique platform to identify and analyze media usage for PIXMOLE's clients. You will be gathering technical information online for our legal department and will take part in protecting copyright for some of the world’s best photographers and artists.

Requirements

  • Experience in OSINT and WEBINT
  • Curious, well-organized, and thorough.
  • Excellent Internet skills.
  • Fluent in English and Hebrew.
  • Fast learner and independent at work.
  • Communicative and a team player.

Copyright Compliance Assistant (Student Position)

We are seeking a diligent and detail-oriented Copyright Compliance Assistant to join our growing team. In this role, you will leverage PIXMOLE's cutting-edge technology to monitor, identify, and analyze media usage for our clients. Your efforts will contribute significantly to the protection of creative works, working hand-in-hand with clients and legal partners to prepare and present technical information critical to copyright enforcement.
